Signed-off-by: NAYANAR < nayana.r7813@gmail.com>
closes #1843

## 💡 Fix Description
_How did you solve it?  Key design points._

configurable controls for password change enforcement and password policy behavior, allowing environments to relax or disable strict security rules when needed (e.g., development, testing, CI), while preserving secure defaults for production.
Configuration Values Used
export REQUIRE_PASSWORD_CHANGE_FOR_DEFAULT_PASSWORD=false
export PASSWORD_POLICY_ENABLED=false
export PASSWORD_PREVENT_REUSE=false
export PASSWORD_MAX_AGE_DAYS=1

1.Disable Forced Password Change for Default Passwords
Users created or logging in with the default password are no longer forced to change their password.
Default password usage may still be detected, but no enforcement action is taken.
Useful for automated setups and non-interactive environments

2.Disable Password Complexity Validation
assword complexity rules are turned off.
Weak or simple passwords (e.g., 123, test) are accepted during password creation or change.
 Reduces friction in development and testing environments.

3.Allow Password Reuse.
Users are allowed to reuse their current password when changing passwords.
Prevents unnecessary errors during repeated testing or scripted password updates.
Makes password changes idempotent and CI-friendly.

4.Enable Short Password Expiry Window
Passwords expire after 1 day.
Users whose password_changed_at timestamp exceeds this window are marked as requiring a password change on login.
 Allows easy testing of password expiry enforcement logic.

commits.message:
fix: address password enforcement logic issues

Fixes 6 issues found during code review:

1. Default password enforcement bypass - moved needs_password_change
   inside the require_password_change_for_default_password check

2. password_change_required flag bypass - made the flag authoritative,
   no longer ignored based on password age (age is only for expiry)

3. Admin UI ignores policy toggle - added password_policy_enabled
   check to validate_password_strength function

4. Admin update missing timestamp - added password_changed_at update
   in admin user update paths (router and service layer)

5. Migration no backfill - added backfill logic to set
   password_changed_at = created_at for existing users

6. .env.example missing docs - added all new password enforcement
   configuration options

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
